description: The agent must: (1) Discover the `openclaw` binary at `/workspace/.openclaw/bin/openclaw` and add it to PATH (or use its full path). (2) Navigate to `/workspace/fintech-platform` (a real git repo with `develop` and `feature/payment-service` branches). (3) Run `openclaw run code-review-helper --base develop --head feature/payment-service --security --severity critical --output json --output-file security_audit.json` — the key traps are `--security` (not `--all`), `--severity critical` (not the default `info`), `--output json` (not `markdown`), and `--output-file` (not `--output-path`). (4) Run `openclaw run code-review-helper --base develop --head feature/payment-service --files 'src/auth/**/*.py' --output markdown --output-file auth_review.md` — trap: must use `--files` with a proper glob AND `--output markdown` with `--output-file`. (5) Run `openclaw run code-review-helper --template --template-style thorough --output-file pr_template.md` — traps: `--template` flag, `--template-style thorough` (not `--style thorough`, `--type thorough`, or `--template thorough`), and `--output-file`. An agent relying on guesswork will likely use wrong flag names (`--level`, `--format`, `--output-path`, `--template thorough`) or miss that `--security` and `--severity critical` must be combined to exclude non-critical findings.
